svg.title: A smoother slalom in the motion model
svg.desc: In an eight-second synthetic slalom at 150 milliseconds round-trip delay with 120 samples per second, the greatest distance between consecutive modeled display positions fell from 6.98 meters to 0.48 meters. The middle 90 percent of displayed speed relative to predicted-body speed, sampled above 10 meters per second, changed from 0–6.96 times to 0.98–1.05 times. The first left-steering response crossing the test threshold changed from 75 to 8.3 milliseconds. A graph plots each display step over the run, before and after.

g.text: Synthetic test · 150 ms round-trip delay · 120 samples / second
